hero.title: Let AI find the meaning. Let Mingpan get the chart right.
hero.description: A deterministic Chinese metaphysics calculator built for AI agents. It computes solar terms, pillars, palaces, stars, and divination charts so the model can focus on understanding, reasoning, and expression.
hero.note: No install or account required. Connect from any client that supports Remote MCP / Streamable HTTP.

principles.title: Put calculation and interpretation where each belongs
principles.description: Mingpan is not another fortune-telling bot. It supplies reproducible chart facts and leaves contextual, human interpretation to the AI you choose.

items.title: Deterministic first
items.description: Pillars, solar terms, palaces, stars, and hexagrams are computed in code—not guessed by a language model.

items.title: Privacy by architecture
items.description: The official service is stateless and does not store or cache birth inputs or chart results.

items.title: Open and auditable
items.description: Source, dependencies, and tests are public so developers and researchers can inspect the calculation conventions.

capabilities.title: Natal charts, timing cycles, and divination through one endpoint
capabilities.description: Every tool returns structured text designed for AI consumption. Mingpan deliberately avoids fortune scores, pattern verdicts, and life conclusions.

items.title: BaZi
items.description: Four pillars, ten gods, hidden stems, na yin, growth stages, decade luck, and annual, monthly, and daily cycles.

items.title: Zi Wei Dou Shu
items.description: Twelve palaces, major and auxiliary stars, four transformations, five-element bureau, and multi-level timing cycles.

items.title: LiuYao
items.description: Primary and transformed hexagrams, Najia, six relatives, six spirits, host/guest lines, void, and hidden spirits.

items.title: MeiHua YiShu
items.description: Time- or number-based casting with primary, mutual, transformed hexagrams and body–function relations.

items.title: Da Liu Ren
items.description: Derives calendar primitives from Gregorian time and returns the heaven–earth plate, four lessons, three transmissions, and generals.

items.title: Qi Men Dun Jia
items.description: Multiple chart styles and intercalation methods, with the nine-palace chart and deterministic yong-shen facts by subject.

capabilities.calendarNote: Plus 2 calendar primitives: precise times for the 24 solar terms and Gregorian–lunar conversion.

connect.title: Give your AI reliable charts in three steps
connect.description: No package download or server maintenance. If your AI client supports Remote MCP, you can use the official service directly.
steps: Open the MCP or Connectors settings in your AI client.
Add a remote service and paste the official MCP endpoint shown here.
Provide the time, gender, or casting data in natural language and ask the AI to use Mingpan.
connect.fairUse: The official service is currently free. Please use it fairly; interfaces and quota policies may evolve as the service matures.

examples.title: Try these after connecting
items: Use Mingpan to calculate a BaZi chart for a male born on April 12, 1992 at 07:30, then interpret the resulting chart.
Find the exact time of LiChun in 2027 and explain whether it changes the year pillar for this birth chart.
Cast a Qi Men Dun Jia hourly chart for June 21, 2024 at 10:00. List the computed facts before interpreting them.

relationship.title: Mingpan computes the chart. BaziWei completes the experience.
relationship.description: Mingpan is an independent, open-source calculation foundation. BaziWei connects subject management, BaZi and Zi Wei, AI readings, calendars, and sharing into a complete product. They complement each other without forcing the same school of interpretation.
